rationale: The event trace is compliant. 1) Ride-through: All trace points (t=0.05s, 0.12s, 0.55s, 0.8s) have voltage above the minimum required by the ride-through curve, and the inverter remains connected at all points. 2) Reactive current: The event starts at t=0.05s. The response deadline is t=0.15s. The voltage is at or below the 0.9 pu threshold at t=0.55s. At this point, which is after the deadline, the reactive current (iq_pu=0.22) meets the minimum requirement (min_iq_pu=0.2).
